name: hud_ui_composite_panel_update
description: HudUiCompositePanel::Update forwards delta time through each visible composite entry's update slot while skipping hidden composite panels.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4bb980 yet; tier S remains open for a later HUD composite-panel update/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4bb980 validates the hidden-flag early return, indexed entry-vector loop using HudUiCompositePanelEntry stride 0x2c0, and dispatch through entry vtable slot 9 (+0x24) with the caller's delta time.

The native composite-panel update smoke verifies visible update dispatch to two entries with self pointers and delta time, hidden-panel skip behavior, composite ftable slot 9 ownership, and transition-text ftable slot 9 binding to HudUiTransitionTextPanel::Update.
